name: EPIC 212021393
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 12.3 solar radii and 1.53 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,628 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.53 solar masses and 12.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,774 K at its surface.
